fire.prompt: Distant, enormous boom of a World War 2 German 88mm anti-tank gun firing in an open field, a deep, violent crack that slams the air, the muzzle blast rolling across the fields and echoing off the hills for seconds.

die.prompt: Heavy anti-tank gun destroyed in its emplacement, a big explosion as its stacked shells go off, steel shield and long barrel crashing down, debris raining onto the dirt, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Heavy anti-tank gun emplaced: a big cross-shaped steel platform lowered to the ground with a deep metal thud, jacks cranked with ratcheting clicks, a huge brass shell rammed into the breech and the breech block slamming shut, close, no music, no voice
